mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ unemployment rate spike, or the unemployment rate explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 1%+ industrial production drop, or industrial production explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of 3-month periods following a 0.5pp+ federal funds rate hike, or the federal funds rate explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate sales signals a weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 5%+ drop in real estate sales, or real estate sales explain < 10% of SPX return variance over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a 300k+ payroll employment gain, or payroll employment explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts signals an improving housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of 3-month periods following a 10%+ rise in housing starts, or housing starts explain < 10% of SPX return variance over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that increase discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5%+ CPI rise, or the CPI explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.
